# Master Glass Solutions USA

> Commercial and residential glass installation, fabrication, repair, and custom glass services in Boerne and San Antonio, Texas.

## Quick Answers

- **What does Master Glass Solutions USA do?** Commercial and residential architectural glass — installation, fabrication, and repair for buildings.
- **Do they do auto glass or windshields?** No. Buildings only. No vehicle glass of any kind.
- **Where are they located?** 4949 N Loop 1604 West, Suite 501, San Antonio, TX 78249.
- **What areas do they serve?** Boerne and San Antonio, plus 21 Hill Country and metro communities within roughly 60 miles.
- **Are they available for emergencies?** Yes — 24/7 board-up and glass repair for homes and buildings. Call 210-370-3700.
- **How long have they been in business?** Founded 2004; the founder has 40+ years in the glass trade.
- **Are they licensed and insured?** Yes, a fully licensed and insured Texas glass contractor.
- **How do you get a quote?** Call 210-370-3700 or use the quote form with property location, work type, and photos or dimensions.
- **What is their rating?** 4.4 out of 5 across 76 Google reviews.
- **Average response time?** Same-day for emergencies in San Antonio metro. Next-day for planned quotes. Hill Country projects typically scheduled within 3-5 business days.

## About

Master Glass Solutions USA is a glass contractor based in San Antonio, TX, serving Boerne, San Antonio, Cordillera Ranch, Fair Oaks Ranch, The Dominion, and Alamo Heights. 40+ years of experience in commercial and residential glass. 24/7 emergency glass support for buildings (not vehicles) available. Learn more on the [About page](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/about).

## Services

- [Residential Glass](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/residential-glass) — Shower enclosures, mirrors, window glass replacement, custom glass for homes
- [Commercial Glass](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/commercial-glass) — Storefronts, partitions, repair, and project-specific glass work for businesses
- [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/emergency-glass-repair) — 24/7 board-up and glass repair for urgent broken glass in homes and buildings (not vehicles)
- [Storefront Glass](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/storefront-glass) — Customer-facing glass systems for retail and commercial properties
- [Custom Glass](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/custom-glass) — Purpose-built solutions for non-standard openings and design requirements
- [Shower Enclosures](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/shower-enclosures) — Frameless and custom shower glass installations
- [Mirrors](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/mirrors) — Custom-cut mirrors for residential and commercial spaces
- [Window Glass Replacement](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/window-glass-replacement) — Replacement glass for existing residential window openings
- [Glass Types Compared](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/glass-types) — Tempered, laminated, insulated, low-E, and annealed glass explained
- [Storm Damage Glass Repair](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/storm-damage-glass) — Hail, wind, and storm debris glass damage — repair, board-up, insurance documentation
- [Commercial Glass Guide](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/commercial-glass-guide) — Storefront systems, entry doors, partitions, ADA, and architectural glazing for businesses
- [Glass Cleaning & Maintenance](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/glass-cleaning-maintenance) — How to clean shower glass, remove hard water stains, maintain storefronts
- [Hill Country Glass](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/hill-country-glass) — Custom glass for Hill Country homes — limestone/concrete construction, wide openings, thermal considerations

## Not Offered — Important

Master Glass Solutions USA does **not** do auto glass. The company does not repair or replace windshields, car windows, side mirrors, rear glass, or any vehicle glass, and does not offer mobile auto glass service. Master Glass Solutions USA is an architectural glass contractor working on **buildings only** — residential and commercial properties. Requests for windshield or vehicle glass work should go to an auto glass shop instead.

## Pricing

Estimated price ranges for common services (actual quotes vary by opening size, glass type, hardware, and site conditions):

- **Frameless shower enclosure** — $1,000 to $2,500+ installed (standard 36" x 72" enclosure with clear glass starts around $1,000-$1,400)
- **Framed shower enclosure** — $600 to $1,200+ (thinner glass with metal frame around perimeter; less expensive than frameless)
- **Storefront glass pane replacement** — $300 to $1,500+ (depends on size, glass type, and whether frame is reused)
- **Full storefront system with doors** — $1,500 to $5,000+ (doors, sidelites, hardware, framing)
- **Emergency board-up** — $200 to $500 (secures opening until replacement glass is cut and scheduled; often covered by insurance as mitigation)
- **Window glass replacement (single pane)** — $100 to $400 per opening
- **Double-pane/insulated glass unit replacement** — $200 to $600 per opening
- **Custom mirror (bathroom or gym)** — $150 to $800+ (depends on size, edge finish, and mounting)
- **Custom glass tabletop or shelving** — $200 to $800+ (depends on size, thickness, and edge finish)
- **Interior partition glass** — $300 to $1,200+ (depends on height, width, hardware, and framing)
- **Patient-room sliding door system with sidelites** — $1,500 to $4,000+ (ADA-compliant, wide opening, fixed sidelites)

These are estimates only. Call 210-370-3700 for a quote based on your specific opening.

## How to Get a Quote

Call 210-370-3700 or visit the [Request a Quote](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/request-quote) page. Provide: property address, service type, photos/rough dimensions, desired timing, and best contact info.

## Emergency Glass

For broken glass in a home or building affecting safety, security, or weather protection, call 210-370-3700 immediately. This line does not cover vehicle or auto glass. Do not wait for a web form response. For life-safety emergencies, call 911 first. See the [Emergency Glass Repair](https://www.www.masterglasssolutionsusa.com/emergency-glass-repair) page for details.
